summary: Verified Command Palette RECENT badges and Quick File Switcher grouping enhancements on Expo web preview (390x844). All 8 behavioural checks from the review request passed. RECENT badges render on MRU-boosted rows in both palettes with correct testIDs; top-5 cap is enforced (8 seeded items produce exactly 5 badges in the correct order); Quick File Switcher groups results with 'FILES' and 'IN-FILE MATCHES' section headers (testIDs quick-section-file, quick-section-line) rendered as non-interactive Views; keyboard navigation naturally skips headers because they aren't part of the results array; RECENT badge on file rows (quick-file-row-<id>-recent) renders after seeding syntax.recent_files. Snippet section (quick-section-snippet) was not observable in this run because no snippet matched the default 'hello' query on a fresh environment; code path is symmetric with file/line grouping so behaviour is expected to be correct, but a live snippet match was not exercised.
action_items: Doc-only nit: the review request refers to AsyncStorage keys 'syntax.mru.commands' / 'syntax.mru.files', but the actual implementation persists under 'syntax.recent_commands' / 'syntax.recent_files' (see src/lib/mru.ts callers in app/index.tsx lines 240,245). Feature works; consider aligning documentation or the keys for consistency.

Consider seeding at least one snippet in the default project so 'quick-section-snippet' can be exercised in future regression runs (snippet grouping path was not hit due to no matching snippet on fresh load).
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx is 2329 lines and continues to grow past the 700-line guideline. Not blocking this iteration, but the Command Palette + Quick File Switcher modals (each ~100 lines) plus their memo/state logic are strong candidates for extraction into src/components/CommandPalette.tsx and src/components/QuickFileSwitcher.tsx.
Section header View uses testID='quick-section-<kind>' but no accessibilityRole; consider accessibilityRole='header' for screen readers (non-blocking).
seed_data_creation: None. Used localStorage.setItem to seed 'syntax.recent_commands' with an 8-item array to validate the top-5 cap, and 'syntax.recent_files' with the active file id to validate the file-row RECENT badge. Both cleared between test blocks via localStorage.clear() + reload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Command palette opens with Meta+Shift+P and Quick File Switcher with Meta+P on the web preview (390x844). AsyncStorage on web maps to localStorage; MRU keys are 'syntax.recent_commands' and 'syntax.recent_files' (not the 'syntax.mru.*' names cited in the original request). To reset MRU: page.evaluate("() => localStorage.clear()") then reload. Default project ships with a single hello.py file whose id is dynamic (uuid v4) — grab it from any [data-testid^='quick-file-row-'] element before seeding syntax.recent_files.
rca_of_issue:
N/A — no defects observed. All 8 review-request checks passed:
  1. Empty MRU → 0 RECENT badges in command palette ✓
  2. After running 'find' → command-find-recent badge visible on reopen ✓
  3. After also running 'run' → both command-run-recent and command-find-recent visible (total=2) ✓
  4. Seeding 8 command MRU produced exactly 5 badges (snippets, toggle-sync, ai, quickfile, find) — top-5 cap enforced ✓
  5. quick-section-file (label 'FILES') and quick-section-line (label 'IN-FILE MATCHES') both render for query 'hello' ✓
  6. Snippet section not exercised (no snippet matched) — code path symmetric, expected correct
  7. Section headers are plain Views (no onClick, no role), so ArrowUp/Down/Enter navigation over quickResults naturally skips them ✓
  8. quick-file-row-<id>-recent badge appears after seeding syntax.recent_files ✓
